items.t: Hi! I have a kind of strange and specific mattress question. I am moving soon and have to pick one of two mattresses to take with me, and I’m not sure what’s better. I’ve slept enough on both and they’ve got pros and cons. One of them is a my fiancés parents Purple mattress they got in ~2020, and the other is a pretty standard/cheapish spring mattress from 2024 that’s lived inside a plastic allergy protector. The Purple is comfier and better on my bad joints, but older and its care is less known to us. And the spring is better for *other* things, which is important for my work situation. Which mattress would you pick? Thanks for your time!
